Minority Protection: Floor weight epsilon
Initialization: Default neutral weight
Update Equation: T_new = T_old + eta * alignment
Drift: Periodic decay
API: POST /api/governance/trust/recalculate
Voting Hook: Integrate with Story 9-2
Transparency: GET /api/governance/trust/{user_id}

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: TrustScore Model: User × Domain → Score (0.0 to 1.0)
Domain Taxonomy: Define domains (security, architecture, data, UX, etc.)
Default Trust: New users start at 0.5 (neutral)
API Endpoint: GET /api/governance/trust/{user_id} returns scores
Claimed Expertise: Self-declared domain knowledge
Demonstrated Expertise: Derived from vote accuracy history
Engagement Factor: Active participants gain trust
Trust Formula: trust = (claimed × 0.2) + (demonstrated × 0.6) + (engagement × 0.2)
Trust Boost: Votes that align with winning decisions increase trust
Trust Decay: Inactivity reduces trust over time (floor at 0.3)
Trust Correction: Votes against outcomes decrease trust slightly
API Endpoint: POST /api/governance/trust/recalculate updates all scores
Vote Weight: weight = base_weight × trust_score[domain]
Domain Detection: Auto-detect relevant domain from proposal
Weight Caps: Max weight = 2.0× to prevent single-user dominance
Transparency: Show weight calculation in vote details
Trust Leaderboard: Top experts per domain
Trust History: Track trust changes over time
Trust Audit: Log all trust modifications
